hero-mount.headline: Scottish
hero-mount.subheadline: Misty glens, Munro summits and whisky-warmed evenings on an eight-day traverse of Scotland's wildest country.

text_intro.text:
Walk the old ways

From the banks of Loch Lomond to the shadow of Ben Nevis, our guided Highland traverse follows drover's tracks and military roads through some of Europe's emptiest mountain country. Short daily stages, warm village inns, and two optional Munro ascents for those who want them.

image_primary.alt: Hiker overlooking a misty Highland glen at dawn

text_body.text:
The route

  • Glasgow → Drymen → Rowardennan along Loch Lomond's eastern shore.
  • Inverarnan, Crianlarich and Tyndrum — classic drover country.
  • The Devil's Staircase and a high route into Kinlochleven.
  • Finish at Fort William under the shadow of Ben Nevis — optional summit day included.

Evenings

Bag drops mean you walk with a daypack while your luggage travels to the next cosy inn. Expect open fires, local ales, and a wee dram of single-malt each night from our guide's private stash.
